verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Hightouch Events collects behavior from websites, mobile apps, and backend systems. Official SDKs cover browser, iOS, Android, and Node.js, plus an HTTP Tracking API with a batch endpoint. A documented event spec defines identify, track, page, screen, and group types. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work as documented, and no per-SDK method-level detail in the pack.
